title: Soft backend: add CKM_RSA_PKCS_PSS
description: wolfCrypt has wc_RsaPSS_Sign and wc_RsaPSS_Verify but wolfP11 does not expose CKM_RSA_PKCS_PSS through C_Sign/C_Verify. Implement PSS sign and verify in wp11_backend_soft.c, add CKM_RSA_PKCS_PSS to g_mechs[], and add the mechanism info case to C_GetMechanismInfo.
